observable.content:
===== about =====
P: Welcome to Corravale University, a place shaped by enduring traditions and devoted to building brighter futures. We invite you to explore the spirited community that makes us the proud home of the Bold & Boundless.
P: Few institutions are positioned as we are to grow into something far greater than the sum of our many distinguished schools and centers. It is precisely this capacity to strengthen the communities we serve that defines our truest worth as a university.
                    View Our Facts & Figures
P: Graduate students gather to review their final projects while relaxing in the sunlit atrium of the Halverson Business College.
===== academics =====
P: Corravale's intellectual energy delivers distinction across every field and around the globe. We are counted among the leaders in higher education thanks to the outstanding strength of our 19 schools and colleges, globally respected faculty, and departments offering 250 degree programs.
P: A student paints in a bright studio at the Arts and Architecture Center on the north campus.
===== life-at-michigan =====
P: Drawing gifted faculty, staff and students from across the globe, the landmark Corravale campus overflows with fresh perspectives, opportunities and events. Everything unfolds within the lively setting of Fairhaven, a city celebrated for its thriving arts scene, culture, parks and restaurants.
P: A student refines a digital illustration in the Visual Arts Studio at the Corravale Student Center.
===== athletics =====
P: Rise Ravens! Corravale's proud athletics heritage began in 1889 and thrives to this day, with our teams earning more than 40 national championships across 15 varsity sports. Students, faculty and staff also take part in dozens of intramural, club sport and fitness programs every year.
P: Corravale Athletics is honored to deliver transformative experiences to over 900 student-athletes competing in 29 sports.
P: Students enjoy an evening tennis match on the Rivergate courts just beyond the Halden-Brooks Residence Hall.
===== research =====
P: With expenditures topping $1 billion, research sits at the core of Corravale's mission and extends across all 19 schools and colleges. Corravale is a strong champion of collaboration and interdisciplinary research initiatives that engage faculty and students from every corner of campus.
P: Corravale researchers have shown that lightweight organic solar cells can reach 8 percent efficiency.
P: Listed here are 25 recent studies that have drawn notice across news outlets, social platforms and other online channels over the past week, spanning coverage from broad general-interest media to scholarly citations. These highlights from Corravale scholars reflect only a small slice of the more than 271,000 research outputs generated each year by our academic community.
===== health-medicine =====
P: Our award-winning Corravale Health System cares for millions of patients, leads hundreds of research studies and prepares thousands of tomorrow's medical professionals every year. For our students, faculty and staff, a broad range of health and wellness services and programs are offered across campus.
P: The Advanced Simulation Lab lets aspiring physicians practice on lifelike patient models at the Corravale Medical College
P: Dana Okafor, pharmacist at Fairmont Grocers, gives a vaccine. Elias Warren, junior at Corravale, receives his shot.
===== initiatives =====
P: Corravale leads a broad range of signature initiatives and outreach programs centered on priority areas that empower us to advance academic excellence, drive meaningful change, and confront the complex global challenges shaping our shared future.
P: CV researchers have received a $2 million federal grant to identify and cultivate green algae that can power a high-yield, environmentally sustainable and cost-effective system for producing clean biofuels.
===== giving =====
P: Corravale is dedicated to putting its academic strength and resources to work for the good of the wider world. A deeply rooted culture of philanthropy is what makes that ambition attainable. The generous commitment of our Corravale donors changes lives each day.
P: Corravale students write thank-you notes expressing their gratitude to alumni and donors
P: An ecology and evolutionary biology student catalogs a collection of aquatic life at the Halvorsen Building.
===== schools-colleges =====
P: Students discover their passions and chart their futures across our 19 nationally recognized schools and colleges — the heart and soul of the Corravale experience at our flagship campus. Meanwhile, our Corravale Westgate and Corravale Alden campuses offer inspiration and direction to more than 15,000 students.
===== prospective-students =====
P: Corravale's commitment to interdisciplinary study empowers students to shape their academic journey around their own career ambitions and personal goals. As one of the nation's largest public research universities, Corravale hosts thousands of active projects that foster meaningful collaboration between students and faculty.
P: Graduate mentors and first-year students run experiments side by side in the Aldridge Discovery Lab
P: A student sketches quietly in a sunlit studio inside the Design and Media Center on the West Quad
===== current-students =====
P: With more than 1,100 student organizations and classmates from all fifty states and 108 countries, life at Corravale rarely stands still. Hundreds of campus tools, guides, events, and resources are here to help every student stay linked to the full campus experience.
P: There's always something remarkable unfolding at Corravale. Whether it's across our campuses or somewhere far beyond them, our students, faculty, staff and alumni are busy chasing what's next. A selection of moments gathered over the years fills the gallery below.
===== faculty-staff =====
P: Corravale is regarded as one of the best places to work in higher education, according to a national review of universities. We place a high priority on building an environment that helps faculty and staff do their finest work, and we value the contributions of every employee in keeping Corravale a leading public institution.
P: Bring your best self to work. Learn how ThriveWell's health and wellness programs boost everyday well-being.
                    Explore ThriveWell's programs and services in depth.
===== parents =====
P: Welcome to the Corravale family. Sending a student to college is a milestone for every household. Corravale is dedicated to helping parents and students make the most of this chapter by sharing up-to-date information about campus life, key dates, and upcoming events.
P: A Corravale parent lends a hand to a first-year student on move-in day at Halden Hall
P: There's always something remarkable unfolding at Corravale. Whether it happens on campus or across the globe, our students, faculty, staff and alumni are busy making the most of each day. A selection of photos gathered over the years appears in the gallery below.
===== alumni =====
P: Corravale's graduates have gone on to reach the far edges of space, to spark movements that reshape culture and to guide nations. No matter how far they travel, they always seem to find their way home. We're proud to count one of the largest and most devoted communities of living alumni anywhere. Go Vale!
P: The ensemble performs on stage during the Fall 2024 New Student Convocation. The student conductor turns toward the audience and raises a fist in triumph. Behind the players, the stage party and a large Welcome to Corravale banner fill the background.

input.command: cd /tmp && cat > /tmp/extract2.py <<'EOF' import re, html, json, subprocess def clean(s): s = re.sub(r']*>', '', s) s = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', s) return html.unescape(s).strip() def extract(page): h = subprocess.run(['curl','-s','http://localhost:35963/'+page+'/'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout i=h.find('id="content"'); j=h.find('id="footer"') seg=h[i:j] if i>0 and j>i else h seg=re.sub(r'','',seg,flags=re.S) chunks = seg.split('nav-block') blocks=[] for ch in chunks[1:]: # cut at end of this block: first sequence then next hm=re.search(r']*>(.*?)', ch, flags=re.S) if not hm: continue title=clean(hm.group(1)) body=ch[hm.end():] # take up to the closing of the list container (last before next nav-block already split) um=re.search(r'', body) if um: body=body[:um.start()] items=[] for am in re.finditer(r']*)>(.*?)', body, flags=re.S): attrs=am.group(1); b=am.group(2) href=re.search(r'href="([^"]*)"',attrs) em=re.search(r']*>(.*?)', b, flags=re.S) txt=clean(re.sub(r']*>.*?','',b,flags=re.S)) items.append({'label':txt,'to':href.group(1) if href else '#','note':clean(em.group(1)) if em else ''}) for sm in re.finditer(r']*>(.*?)', body, flags=re.S): items.append({'label':clean(sm.group(1)),'to':'','note':'','expand':True}) blocks.append({'title':title,'items':items}) return blocks out={} for page in ['about','academics','life-at-michigan','athletics','research','health-medicine','initiatives','giving','schools-colleges','prospective-students','current-students','faculty-staff','parents','alumni']: out[page]=extract(page) print(json.dumps(out, indent=1)) EOF python3 /tmp/extract2.py > /tmp/groups2.json 2>&1; python3 -c " import json d=json.load(open('/tmp/groups2.json')) for k,v in d.items(): print('=====',k) for b in v: print(' ',b['title']) for it in b['items']: print(' -',it['label'],'|',it['to'],'|',it['note'], '| expand' if it.get('expand') else '') "
